question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**principal**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage refers to the main warriors on the Trojan side in the context of Hector and the Trojan War.
 
• The appropriate adjective should describe the main or most important warriors.
 
• "**Principal**" fits well as it means the most important or main, which aligns with the context of referring to key warriors in the war.
 
• Other options ("**highest**", "**absolute**", "**maximum**") do not specifically convey the idea of being the main or most important warriors.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *King Priam of Troy was old and weak, but his son Hector was a (1)** brave**__ and noble young man. Hector had sensed (2) __** trouble**__ when his brother had brought Helen to Troy. He (3) __** understood**__ that he must fight for his family but (4) __** regretted**__ the circumstances that had set hero against hero. The (5) __** principal **__warriors on the Trojan side were Achilles, Aeneas and Agamemnon.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Highest (उच्चतम): "Highest" refers to something at the greatest height or level, which is not the best fit for describing important warriors.
 
• Absolute (पूर्ण): "Absolute" means complete and total, which does not specifically convey the idea of being the main or most important warriors.
 
• Maximum (अधिकतम): "Maximum" refers to the greatest possible amount, which does not describe important or main warriors effectively.
